# Lineage register

<!-- GENERATED by lineage/lineage.py from lineage/lineage.json. Edit the JSON, then run `python3 lineage/lineage.py render`. -->

Every change this proposal makes to what exists today is a **mutation** with a stable ID. Each names its **parents**: a pinned line in Workwarrior, MobileOS/ZAKO or the research notes; an earlier entry; or an external source. The register is append-only. A superseded entry stays, with links in both directions, so the reasoning behind every change can be followed back to the line it changes. `python3 lineage/lineage.py check` verifies every pinned line at its commit, every supersession link, and every 'recorded in' anchor. Nothing here is ratified. Ratification happens through [issue #1](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/issues/1).

## Pacioli

Substrate in the archived plan: append-only, with state as a derivation. Also the conservation thesis in units-v1.

### PAC-1

**Ingest appends; time order becomes a view** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:services/stream/stream.sh:707`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/stream.sh#L707); [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:85`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L85)
- **Mutation:** Ingest appends in arrival order and never re-sorts the file. Occurrence order is computed by views.
- **Why:** The in-place sort rewrites every line, which contradicts the plan's own append-only rule and breaks append position as an address.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### 6.1 Append only)

### PAC-2

**Reset seals the segment and starts an epoch** · `proposed`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:services/stream/stream.sh:579`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/stream.sh#L579); [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:86`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L86)
- **Mutation:** Reset no longer truncates. It seals the current segment and opens the next one as an epoch, and views start from the latest epoch by default.
- **Why:** Truncation erases the history that Pacioli's principle says is the only truth.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (**Reset becomes an epoch.**)
- **Note:** Specified, but not exercised by the trial.

### PAC-3

**Segments close with a seal in a hash chain** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md:239`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md#L239); [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:85`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L85)
- **Mutation:** Each segment ends with an `S seal` record carrying a sha256 of the segment body and a chain hash linked to the previous seal.
- **Why:** Append-only was a rule with nothing enforcing it. A seal makes a rewrite detectable.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### 6.3 Seals)

### PAC-4

**Ledger records carry balanced legs** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:services/stream/lib/adapters.sh:293`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lib/adapters.sh#L293); [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/units-v1.md:18`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/units-v1.md#L18)
- **Mutation:** `L.post` carries its legs. Every posting balances on its own, per (book, unit), never per batch.
- **Why:** The v1 ledger adapter records that a posting happened but omits its amount, so balances can't be rebuilt.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### 8.2 Balance rule)

### PAC-5

**The count-based Pacioli lens becomes a balance view** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:services/stream/lenses/pacioli.sh:11`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lenses/pacioli.sh#L11); [`workwarrior:services/stream/lenses/pacioli.sh:36`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lenses/pacioli.sh#L36); [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:88`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L88)
- **Mutation:** The current lens is retired. The Pacioli name passes to a view of real quantity balances, and activity counts per object move to Burroughs and Hollerith.
- **Why:** A start followed by a stop gives a 'balance' of 2. A count of events is not a quantity.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N12.4 Retire)

### PAC-6

**A period close records the balances** · `superseded`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:85`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L85); [`mobileos:ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Wire-Conventions-v1.md:160`](https://github.com/babbworks/mobileos/blob/8c33c650e8090e810324d35d0ecf1c5f12319082/ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Wire-Conventions-v1.md#L160); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md:404`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md#L404)
- **Mutation:** A period close (COMMIT or Tally) restates the balances in a record.
- **Superseded by:** [PAC-7](#pac-7)
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (**Refinement 2.**)

### PAC-7

**A period close commits to the balances by hash** · `agreed` · cost: one fixed-size record per period

- **Descends from:** [PAC-6](#pac-6); [`mobileos:ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Wire-Conventions-v1.md:160`](https://github.com/babbworks/mobileos/blob/8c33c650e8090e810324d35d0ecf1c5f12319082/ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Wire-Conventions-v1.md#L160)
- **Mutation:** The close record carries a hash of the full balance table, the period and a record count, not the balances themselves. Readers verify by replay. A hash tree is optional, for proving one account.
- **Why:** Restating balances costs bytes that grow with the number of accounts. A hash is fixed size and verifiable.
- **Supersedes:** [PAC-6](#pac-6)
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### Balance rules)

### PAC-8

**Records carry movements, never balances** · `agreed` · cost: saves bytes

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:87`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L87)
- **Mutation:** No record states a running balance, remainder or rate. They are computed by views.
- **Why:** This rules out the bank-statement pattern of writing a balance on every line.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (**Records carry movements, never balances (PAC-8).**)

### PAC-9

**A total is written only when it is independent evidence** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [PAC-8](#pac-8); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md:62`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md#L62)
- **Mutation:** A parent's `use` appears only when something measured it separately, such as a host meter. Otherwise the view adds up the children.
- **Why:** A recorded sum of recorded parts is a restated balance.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (**A total is written only when it is independent evidence (PAC-9).**)

### PAC-10

**Resource use is drawn from a declared pool** · `agreed` · cost: 0 per record

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/punch-posting-v1.md:14`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/punch-posting-v1.md#L14); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md:403`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md#L403)
- **Mutation:** This generalises punch-posting-v1's capacity posting from actor-hours to every conserved quantity. The pool (host energy, token allowance, actor capacity) is declared in the run header, which makes consumption double-entry at no cost per record.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (**Refinement 1.**)

### PAC-11

**Overlapping punches could consume an actor's hours twice** · `open`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/punch-posting-v1.md:22`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/punch-posting-v1.md#L22); [BUN-1](#bun-1)
- **Mutation:** Should an actor's capacity be split across overlapping intervals, or should overlap be reported as over-attribution (NOT-4)?
- **Why:** punch-posting-v1 posts one transaction per interval. Once BUN-1 keeps overlapping intervals apart, an operator on two machines at once would debit their hours twice.

## Hollerith

Substrate in the archived plan: positional encoding and compact symbolic codes.

### HOL-1

**Objects are declared once; acts carry only the ID** · `agreed` · cost: saves bytes

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:services/stream/lib/adapters.sh:79`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lib/adapters.sh#L79); [`workwarrior:services/stream/lib/adapters.sh:146`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lib/adapters.sh#L146); [`mobileos:ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Codebook-Standard-v1.md:72`](https://github.com/babbworks/mobileos/blob/8c33c650e8090e810324d35d0ecf1c5f12319082/ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Codebook-Standard-v1.md#L72); [`mobileos:ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Codebook-Standard-v1.md:73`](https://github.com/babbworks/mobileos/blob/8c33c650e8090e810324d35d0ecf1c5f12319082/ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Codebook-Standard-v1.md#L73)
- **Mutation:** An object's attributes (name, project, tags, kind, class) move into one CREATE or BIND declaration. Acts carry only the object's ID. Renaming is one modification of the object.
- **Why:** Adapters repeat object attributes in ctx on every line, and the Hollerith grid gets unreliable columns.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N12.1 Declare objects)

### HOL-2

**Canonical lines keep the full ID; short references only in compact forms** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:112`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L112)
- **Mutation:** The canonical line stays self-contained, with the full stable ID. Dictionary indices appear only in the run form and binary.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N12.1 Declare objects)

### HOL-3

**Undeclared objects are accepted and flagged** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [HOL-1](#hol-1); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md:132`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md#L132)
- **Mutation:** A reference to an undeclared object is accepted and reported by views, not rejected.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N12.1 Declare objects)

### HOL-4

**The record type fixes payload positions** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:91`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L91); [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md:89`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md#L89)
- **Mutation:** Each type's vocabulary entry defines the order and types of its payload values, so key names disappear from rows.

- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (## N7. Run form)

### HOL-5

**Time-sorted storage** · `declined`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:110`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L110); [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md:28`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md#L28)

## Burroughs

Tier A, event accumulation. The adding machine's listing tape, and its governor.

### BUR-1

**Retry identity replaces 4-tuple dedup** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:services/stream/lib/adapters.sh:6`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lib/adapters.sh#L6); [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md:61`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md#L61)
- **Mutation:** A submission is a retry when it has the same (recorder, producer sequence or retry key). Two identical occurrences are two records.
- **Why:** Dedup on (ts, OP, action, object) silently drops a distinct actor's punch. The trial reproduces this against the shipped code. This is the Burroughs governor: the result doesn't depend on how the handle was pulled.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### 6.5 Receipts and retries)

### BUR-2

**Rejections are journaled** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [BUR-1](#bur-1)
- **Mutation:** A rejected submission with a retry identity writes an `S reject` receipt, so a retry gets the same answer.
- **Why:** Without it, the capture-gap view couldn't tell 'rejected' from 'never received'. The trial found this.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### 6.5 Receipts and retries)

### BUR-3

**Every figure carries its provenance** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:62`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L62)
- **Mutation:** Core views return the addresses each figure came from. A correction chain walks back to its original evidence. This is the listing tape.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### 7.2 Provenance)

## Baldwin

Tier A, state mutation differencing.

### BAL-1

**Mutations of shared objects carry the version they were based on** · `agreed` · cost: 1–2 bytes, shared objects only

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:63`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L63); [FRI-1](#fri-1)
- **Mutation:** A mutation states its base version. The new version is base + 1. Two accepted changes on the same base are reported as a conflict. Frick's 'from' state is worked out from the version.
- **Why:** A version covers every mutation, not just state transitions, and it exposes concurrent writers.
- **Supersedes:** [FRI-1](#fri-1)
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N13.1 Base version)

### BAL-2

**Snapshots are caches, not records** · `agreed` · cost: 0 to the journal

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md:87`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/archive/plans/wwss-stream-service.md#L87); [PAC-7](#pac-7)
- **Mutation:** Object-state and balance snapshots live outside the journal. Each is keyed to a journal address and checked against the period-close hash, and each can be dropped and rebuilt.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (**Snapshots are caches, not records (BAL-2).**)

## Bundy

Tier B, interval segmentation. The punch clock and trusted time.

### BUN-1

**Intervals pair on run, otherwise on (object, actor)** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:services/stream/lenses/bundy.sh:36`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lenses/bundy.sh#L36); [`workwarrior:services/stream/lenses/board.sh:66`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lenses/board.sh#L66)
- **Mutation:** An interval gets its identity when it begins, so overlapping intervals on one object stay separate.
- **Why:** The shipped Bundy lens reports one 10-minute interval where 20 and 40 minutes of overlapping work happened. The trial reproduces this.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-JOURNAL-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### 4.4 Pairing)

### BUN-2

**Begin and end become the phase of a type** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [`ww-standard:times-research/times-synthesis-one.md:35`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/96cb9f84e70ef9d98a86bad6f2d57d95892dc253/times-research/times-synthesis-one.md#L35); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md:282`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md#L282)
- **Mutation:** Start and stop move out of the action word and into the 2-bit phase (begin, end), which applies to any verb.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (### The type)

### BUN-3

**A punch is ATTEND, not START or FINISH** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [`mobileos:ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Codebook-Standard-v1.md:151`](https://github.com/babbworks/mobileos/blob/8c33c650e8090e810324d35d0ecf1c5f12319082/ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Codebook-Standard-v1.md#L151); [ZAK-6](#zak-6)
- **Mutation:** Operator presence maps to ATTEND 0x36, begin and end. Completing a work item stays FINISH 0x23.
- **Why:** With phase separated from the verb, ZAKO already has the verb for a punch clock.
- **Supersedes:** [ZAK-6](#zak-6)
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (ATTEND 0x36, begin and end)

### BUN-4

**Each session declares its clock provenance and timezone** · `agreed` · cost: 0 per record

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md:28`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md#L28); [`workwarrior:services/stream/lenses/cooper.sh:81`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/services/stream/lenses/cooper.sh#L81)
- **Mutation:** The session declares its clock source (synced device, free-running device, GPS, server receipt or person), precision, last known offset at sync, and an IANA timezone. 'Unknown' is allowed and flagged. Receipt time serves as a second clock.
- **Why:** The worker supplies the act; the clock supplies the time. Today an offline phone, a server and a person typing a time all produce the same integer.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N12.3 Clock provenance)

### BUN-5

**Times supplied by a person are claims** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md:180`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md#L180)
- **Mutation:** This generalises v1's `reconciled` marking from missing punch-outs to any time a person supplies.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N12.3 Clock provenance)

## Dey

## Babbage

The Engine mapping, the Difference Engine, and *On the Economy of Machinery and Manufactures*.

### BAB-1

**Records say what class of resource performed the act** · `agreed` · cost: 0 normally

- **Descends from:** *Babbage, On the Economy of Machinery and Manufactures (1832): divide work by the skill each part needs*; [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/actors-v1.md:71`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/actors-v1.md#L71); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/reference/test_conformance.py:70`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/reference/test_conformance.py#L70)
- **Mutation:** The class (model, machine class, labour grade) is declared per actor. It is recorded per act only when the class that served the act differed from the declared one, such as a model fallback or work moved to another machine.
- **Why:** Allotment analysis asks whether a cheaper class would have done the work, which is impossible without the class. The scenario already carried `model` per token reading.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (N13.2 Class of resource)

### BAB-2

**A series is encoded as a start value plus differences** · `proposed`

- **Descends from:** [`ww-standard:times-research/babbage-lovelace-framework.md:301`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/96cb9f84e70ef9d98a86bad6f2d57d95892dc253/times-research/babbage-lovelace-framework.md#L301); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/reference/compact.py:20`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/reference/compact.py#L20)
- **Mutation:** Compact forms may delta-code a series (base plus differences, or difference of differences). The canonical meaning is unchanged.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (Difference Engine)

### BAB-3

**Cumulative counters keep their reading and are delta-coded** · `agreed`

- **Descends from:** [BAB-2](#bab-2); [PAC-8](#pac-8)
- **Mutation:** A cumulative counter (for example RAPL `energy_uj`) keeps its reading in canonical form, so a lost sample loses nothing. Compact forms store the change.
- **Why:** This is the one place where restating a running value is worth it, and the encoding removes its cost.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (**Exception: cumulative counters (BAB-3).**)

### NOT-1

**Run form: state once, then values** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md:95`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/stream-event-v1.md#L95); [`mobileos:ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Pictography-Standard-v1.md:39`](https://github.com/babbworks/mobileos/blob/8c33c650e8090e810324d35d0ecf1c5f12319082/ZAKO/CORE/ZAKO-Pictography-Standard-v1.md#L39)
- **Mutation:** A header states the shared context and the rows carry only what changes. It decodes to canonical lines byte for byte.
- **Why:** Measured: 45% smaller on mixed records, 96.5% smaller on periodic ones.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (## N7. Run form)

### NOT-2

**A separate quantity codebook** · `superseded`

- **Descends from:** [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/reference/vocab/notation-0.1.json:58`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/reference/vocab/notation-0.1.json#L58)
- **Mutation:** notation-0.1.json defines its own quantity codes.
- **Superseded by:** [NOT-3](#not-3)

### NOT-3

**Quantity codes extend units-v1** · `proposed`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/units-v1.md:60`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/units-v1.md#L60); [NOT-2](#not-2)
- **Mutation:** The existing unit registry gains a `conserved` flag, a short code and its ZAKO quantity type. notation-0.1.json keeps no codebook of its own.
- **Why:** units-v1 is already the shared vocabulary of quantity, and it keeps conversion apart from price. A second codebook would split that vocabulary.
- **Supersedes:** [NOT-2](#not-2)

### NOT-4

**Close records carry a use vector; wall time is the envelope** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [`workwarrior:dev/schemas/punch-posting-v1.md:14`](https://github.com/babbworks/workwarrior/blob/ce7379f488d01e5e3f9e351d3e014b4529e3892e/dev/schemas/punch-posting-v1.md#L14); [`ww-standard:proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md:62`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/f42999f756c5de5c6e0b644ba1490b0e4097cfc0/proposals/stream-journal/STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md#L62)
- **Mutation:** Conserved quantities add up and leave a stated remainder. An act's own wall time is reported as an envelope, with utilisation and parallelism ratios.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (## N3. The atom: an act)
- **Note:** See PAC-11 for actor-hours under overlap.

### NOT-5

**Declared recording depth; below it, counts and totals** · `trialled`

- **Descends from:** [NOT-4](#not-4); [`ww-standard:times-research/babbage-lovelace-framework.md:83`](https://github.com/babbworks/ww-standard/blob/96cb9f84e70ef9d98a86bad6f2d57d95892dc253/times-research/babbage-lovelace-framework.md#L83)
- **Mutation:** A stream declares the deepest level it records. Acts below that level appear only as `#` counts and in the parent's totals, and the remainder is explicit.
- **Recorded in:** `STREAM-NOTATION-v0.1-DRAFT.md` (## N4. The cascade and recording resolution)
- **Note:** The framework's Level is a different axis (derivation tier). This is action depth.

## Supersession chains

| Was | Became | Why |
|---|---|---|
| [PAC-6](#pac-6) | [PAC-7](#pac-7) | Restating balances costs bytes that grow with the number of accounts. A hash is fixed size and verifiable. |
| [FRI-1](#fri-1) | [BAL-1](#bal-1) | A version covers every mutation, not just state transitions, and it exposes concurrent writers. |
| [ZAK-6](#zak-6) | [BUN-3](#bun-3) | With phase separated from the verb, ZAKO already has the verb for a punch clock. |
| [ZAK-12](#zak-12) | [ZAK-1](#zak-1) | A universal verb in the type carries meaning that today rides in ctx on every record, and it makes acts comparable across people, machines and agents. |
| [NOT-7](#not-7) | [ZAK-1](#zak-1) | A universal verb in the type carries meaning that today rides in ctx on every record, and it makes acts comparable across people, machines and agents. |
| [NOT-2](#not-2) | [NOT-3](#not-3) | units-v1 is already the shared vocabulary of quantity, and it keeps conversion apart from price. A second codebook would split that vocabulary. |
